title: POKÉMON Detective Pikachu and the LEGO SPY GADGETS MYSTERY!
description:
POKÉMON Detective Pikachu solves the Lego Spy Gadget mystery today! When agent Tex's Lego set goes missing Detective Pikachu shows up to help solve the mystery. Afterwards Axel and his daddy build spy gadgets out of the Legos! 

This was a super fun pretend play skit.
